examples.chinese: 這個孩子眼睛不太好，所以每天都戴眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǎnjing bù tài hǎo, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu dài yǎnjìng.
examples.english: This child's eyes are not very good, so he wears glasses every day.

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 他上班時常戴著一副黑色眼鏡，那副樣子總是讓我忘不了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàngbān shí cháng dài zhe yī fù hēisè yǎnjìng, nà fù yàngzi zǒngshì ràng wǒ wàng bù liǎo.
examples.english: When he goes to work, he often wears a pair of black glasses; that look always makes me unable to forget it.

examples.chinese: 我把搭車的日期、時間都記下來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ dā chē de rìqī, shíjiān dōu jì xiàlái le.
examples.english: I have written down the date and time of the train ride.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐從小就愛史努比，所以臥房裡到處都是史努比的娃娃。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù ài Shǐnǔbǐ, suǒyǐ wòfáng lǐ dàochù dōu shì Shǐnǔbǐ de wáwa.
examples.english: Miss Chen has loved Snoopy since childhood, so there are Snoopy dolls everywhere in her bedroom.

examples.chinese: 我們從小學到大學都是同學，也是很好的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng xiǎoxué dào dàxué dōu shì tóngxué, yě shì hěn hǎo de péngyǒu.
examples.english: From elementary school to university, we have always been classmates and also very good friends.

examples.chinese: 小明從小就很勇敢，希望長大後能當一名好警察。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng cóngxiǎo jiù hěn yǒnggǎn, xīwàng zhǎngdà hòu néng dāng yī míng hǎo jǐngchá.
examples.english: Xiaoming has been brave since childhood, and he hopes that when he grows up he can become a good police officer.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 小藍從小在育幼院長大，最大的願望就是將來能有一個溫暖的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiānglái néng yǒu yī gè wēnnuǎn de jiātíng.
examples.english: Xiao Lan grew up in an orphanage; her greatest wish is to have a warm family in the future.

examples.chinese: 從小父母就教導我要做個好人，別讓人看不起自己。
examples.pinyin: Cóngxiǎo fùmǔ jiù jiàodǎo wǒ yào zuò ge hǎorén, bié ràng rén kànbuqǐ zìjǐ.
examples.english: Since I was little, my parents taught me to be a good person and not let others look down on me.

examples.chinese: 中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu. Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together. Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 從小我父母就去世了，一直是我大哥、大嫂在照顧我的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngxiǎo wǒ fùmǔ jiù qùshì le, yīzhí shì wǒ dàgē, dàsǎo zài zhàogù wǒ de.
examples.english: My parents passed away when I was little; it has always been my eldest brother and sister-in-law who have been taking care of me.

examples.chinese: 他們從小時候就很要好，有困難時一起解決，有好東西也會分給對方。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen cóng xiǎoshíhou jiù hěn yàohǎo, yǒu kùnnán shí yīqǐ jiějué, yǒu hǎo dōngxi yě huì fēn gěi duìfāng.
examples.english: They have been close friends since childhood; when they have difficulties, they solve them together, and when they have good things, they share them with each other.

examples.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎoshíhou qǐ, tā de dì-yī zhìyuàn jiùshì dāng yī wèi bǎohù guójiā de jūnrén.
examples.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

items.wordHook: A handy item for 凳(bench) with suffix 子(child): 凳子 means stool.

examples.chinese: 過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Guòdù xiāofèi jí shǐyòng sùjiāo cáiliào de chǎnpǐn, dōu huì zēngjiā zìrán huánjìng de fùdān.
examples.english: Excessive consumption and the use of plastic material products will both increase the burden on the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 環保署規定禁止使用塑膠袋後，使用購物袋的人就漸漸增加了。
examples.pinyin: Huánbǎoshǔ guīdìng jìnzhǐ shǐyòng sùjiāodài hòu, shǐyòng gòuwùdài de rén jiù jiànjiàn zēngjiā le.
examples.english: After the Environmental Protection Administration banned the use of plastic bags, the number of people using shopping bags gradually increased.

examples.chinese: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng yīnyuè xuéyuàn bìyè yǐhòu jiù jiārù gējùtuán, dào shìjiè gèdì biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: After graduating from the music conservatory, he joined an opera troupe and performed all over the world.

examples.chinese: 最近酒後開車的車禍新聞越來越多，政府得好好處罰這些人。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn jiǔhòu kāichē de chēhuò xīnwén yuè lái yuè duō, zhèngfǔ děi hǎohǎo chǔfá zhèxiē rén.
examples.english: Recently there has been more and more news of car accidents from drunk driving; the government must properly punish these people.

items.wordHook: Offering reverent worship before the 礻(spirit) altar: 神(god).
Two mirrored barriers stand back to back, opposing each other → the sign of refusal: 非(not).
